verdict.rationale: Carta's docs show it holds the issuer's capitalization table by share class, with stakeholders, option grants (including drafts awaiting board approval), convertible notes, SAFEs and 409A fair market values. Fund operators and law firms can pull this cap table data directly, which supports its role as the record investors rely on. Missing for 10: any mention of share certificates; evidence of auditor access or reliance; documentation of the founder-facing editing workflow beyond read APIs and draft-grant creation; independent hands-on corroboration that it works as a live record.
